message.content:
The default capabilities include `SMTP_CAPABILITY_CHUNKING`, so BDAT is supported. The fuzz target uses default capabilities. So the test input should work.

Now let me create the PoC file. The input is the raw bytes sent to the SMTP server. Let me create the file with the exact test input.

Let me first check how the fuzz target reads input - it uses `FUZZ_BEGIN_FD` which reads from a file descriptor. The input is the raw SMTP data.

Let me create the PoC file:

```
MAIL FROM:\r\n
DATA\r\n
DATA\r\n
RCPT TO:\r\n
BDAT 0\r\n
```

Let me create this file.
